Meet Cheng and Aatmodhee. Cheng Yuan joined our Engineering team as Founding Infra Engineer, supporting the team by building and improving the systems, tooling, and processes that help everyone develop and ship more reliably. Before Luzid, he was one of the first software engineers at Otter AI. Outside work, he enjoys listening to music and playing classical guitar. Aatmodhee Goswami joined us as Founding ML Engineer. He’ll be working on our project management task automation products. Outside work, he sings Indian classical music, tries new sports like windsurfing, drives naturally aspirated convertibles down mountain roads, flies drones, and follows soccer, especially FC Barcelona. He also has a few stories already: he once got stuck in a country during a revolution and has climbed mountains in the Himalayas. Welcome to the team, Cheng and Aatmodhee. Let’s build.
